# Globe Gazers

> > Solo female travel guides and destination tips empowering women travelers worldwide.

Globe Gazers is a travel blog founded by Nausheen, offering comprehensive destination guides, safety tips, and travel advice specifically tailored for solo female travelers. The site covers popular destinations including Santorini, Mexico, and Chicago, with a focus on women empowerment and practical travel planning.
